title: Variance Restoration over Covariance Rank: Memory-Budgeted Analytic Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analytic continual learning replaces iterative gradient updates with closed-form ridge regression over frozen pre-trained representations, summarizing all past sessions in two running sufficient statistics: the feature autocorrelation matrix $\Sigma_t$ and the class cross-correlation matrix $\Gamma_t$. Lifting backbone features into a wide random code of dimension $M \gg D$ substantially improves linear separability across tasks, but forces $\Sigma_t$ to grow quadratically as $\mathcal{O}(M^2)$. Under a fixed persistent memory envelope $\Bcal$, a learner faces a fundamental structural trade-off: store exact pairwise co-activations inside a narrower feature code, or expand to a wide code while compressing cross-coordinate interactions. We observe that the coordinate self-variances $v_t = \diag(\Sigma_t)$ and class statistics $\Gamma_t$ grow only linearly with $M$, whereas off-diagonal interactions dominate memory. translated_title: 方差恢复优于协方差秩：内存预算约束下的解析持续学习
translated_abstract: 解析持续学习用作用于冻结预训练表征的闭式岭回归取代迭代梯度更新，将所有历史会话总结为两个持续更新的充分统计量：特征自相关矩阵 $\Sigma_t$ 和类别互相关矩阵 $\Gamma_t$。将骨干网络特征提升到维度 $M \gg D$ 的宽随机码中能显著改善跨任务的线性可分性，但会使 $\Sigma_t$ 以 $\mathcal{O}(M^2)$ 的速度二次增长。在固定的持久内存预算 $\Bcal$ 下，学习者面临一个基本的结构性权衡：要么在较窄的特征码中存储精确的成对共激活信息，要么扩展到宽码同时压缩跨坐标的交互作用。我们观察到，坐标自方差 $v_t = \diag(\Sigma_t)$ 和类别统计量 $\Gamma_t$ 仅随 $M$ 线性增长，而内存开销主要由非对角的交互项主导。我们提出了 \method……（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文针对固定内存预算下的解析持续学习，提出只保存随维度线性增长的坐标方差与类别统计量、以替代二次增长的完整协方差矩阵，从而在保留宽随机码带来的线性可分性提升的同时大幅降低内存开销。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes memory-budgeted analytic continual learning that retains only the linearly-growing coordinate variances and class statistics instead of the quadratically-growing full covariance matrix, preserving the linear separability benefits of wide random codes under a fixed memory envelope.
